get.summary: List connected supervisor instances with watchdog state & health

post.description: Only the settings present in the body are changed. The new state is stored and pushed to connected supervisors; offline supervisors receive it when they reconnect. Each node's supervisor.yaml is its discovery default: discovery_enabled overrides it, and discovery_use_node_default: true removes that override so the node decides again (do not send both). Disabling discovery keeps the node's last scan (shown greyed for up to 7 days) and ignores later full scans from it; applications CollectorCtrl instrumented stay listed and manageable. Returns per-instance results (updated, not_found, invalid, failed); the status is 200 when at least one instance was updated, otherwise 400, 404 or 500. Every call is written to the audit log.
